name: Horizon Surgical Systems
description: Horizon Surgical Systems is a medical robotics company based in Los Angeles, California, USA, founded in 2021 as a spin-off from the UCLA Stein Eye Institute and Henry Samueli School of Engineering. The company develops the [Polaris](/robot/horizon_polaris) micro-robotic ophthalmic surgical platform with optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging and computer vision guidance for cataract surgery.
